name: pdf-form-collector
description: Gather the answers from a stack of filled-in PDF forms into one spreadsheet. Text boxes, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns and signature fields all become columns, labelled the way the form labels them. It highlights required fields left empty, unticked consent boxes, bad emails or phone numbers, repeat submissions and PDFs that aren't fillable at all. Fix values in the table, then export Excel with the problem cells coloured and noted, or CSV. Runs locally; no upload or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把一批填好的 PDF 表单汇总成一张表：文本框、复选框、单选、下拉框和签名字段都变成列，列名用表单上的提示文字。必填项没填、同意框没勾、邮箱或手机号格式不对、重复提交、不能填写的 PDF（扫描件或已压平）都会标出来。在表格里修正后，导出带颜色和批注的 Excel 或 CSV。在本地运行，不上传，无需 API 密钥。
